items.quote: Now the customer is using this to proactively look into who are the other vulnerable clients who might complain and what are the risks they have.

items.statement: Identified hundreds of agents implementable across Intellect products
items.quote: We have identified hundreds of agents that can be implemented within our intellect products.

items.statement: Revenue potential of INR 1,000-5,000 crores over 5 years from Purple Fabric AI platform
items.quote: 1000 crore we are sure of it in next 4 years we will be able to capitalise on it. Can 1,000 crores be 5000 crore opportunity for us at a margin of 50%?

items.statement: Target 50-100 clients for Purple Fabric platform subscription at $1M per year within 4 years
items.quote: if we can reach out to 50 to 100 clients in next 4 years, that's the kind of an objective that we are looking at it

items.statement: Each AI use case targets minimum Rs.100 crores revenue in 3-5 years
items.quote: Each Use Case we are looking at it that each use case, it should be minimum Rs.100 crores revenue index 3 to 5 years.

items.statement: Expect 20% headcount reduction in software testing within 6 months using Purple Fabric
items.quote: we are going to leverage almost 20% headcount reduction for the same job in next 6 months.

items.statement: AI product margins will be higher than existing enterprise products
items.quote: Margin will definitely be higher. This is a very distinctively different AI product. Today, AI margins are still on higher side.

items.statement: Cumulative investments of few hundred crores made in AI platform across balance sheet and UK subsidiaries
items.quote: Cumulative investments in this business over few 100 crores were made.. Something is available in our balance sheet capitalisation. Something is available in UK subsidiaries.

items.statement: Pipeline of 100+ leads doing PoCs, 20 US clients live on underwriting, 1 client live on claims, ESG customer live
items.quote: today we have pipeline of more than 100 leads where we are doing the PoCs with them so that they can on board.

items.statement: 2-3 year moat from applied banking domain expertise and patents; foundational AI players lack BFSI last-mile competency
items.quote: At least it is a two year to three-year moat available to us on an applying in banking financial sector which I have talking about black book.

items.statement: Regulatory clarity awaited from Indian Central Bank before scaling AI in domestic market
items.quote: India rules are not clear where they can use where they cannot use Central Bank has not issued any notification. How can they use AI or not.

items.statement: Revenue build-up accelerates after PoC acceptance; not quarter-to-quarter linear growth
items.quote: Hundreds of crores we are saying it's an accelerating revenue not a quarter-to-quarter revenue. So please don't expect anything significantly change in quarterly revenue

items.statement: GTM investments increasing significantly with marketing teams being built in US and UK as first phase
items.quote: Our GTM Investments will be much higher. We are we are creating a good marketing department in US and UK. These are 2 countries we picked up as a first phase of going there.

items.statement: Signing 8-10 deals per quarter (POCs), each with potential to grow to $1-3M ARR
items.quote: each quarter we are signing around 8 to 10 deals. There may be small POC, they may big POC which may not reflect on the revenue as much in each quarter.

items.statement: AI will eliminate 30% of Indian software engineering jobs in 2026; industry disruption inevitable
items.quote: Within a software engineering business, I believe that 30% of our engineering service industry will lose their jobs in 2026.

items.statement: Open to corporate action to capture 1,000-5,000 crore value journey; discussing at board level
items.quote: We can think about something of that nature where we can leverage it better, subsidise it something we don't know as of now. We are just discussing it how do you really capture the value of 1000 crore to 5000 crore journeys?

items.statement: Target to grow revenue beyond 15% year on year going forward
items.quote: Yes, this percentage can definitely increase and our target is definitely to grow beyond 15% year on year.

items.statement: Planned capex outlay of around INR70 crores per year going forward
items.quote: So we approximately have a capex outlay of around INR70 crores per year that we have planned going forward, because we plan to add 12 to 15 centres every year from FY'25 going forward.

items.statement: Plan to improve EBITDA margins by 300 basis points year-on-year
items.quote: Absolutely, because as we expand our business and the economies of scale is setting in, we are seeing our margins are improving and like our peers have already demonstrated in an integrated model, these are sustainable margins going forward and we definitely plan to increase or improve our margins by 300 basis points year-on-year.

items.statement: Lease cost as percentage of revenue expected to decline from 6-7% to 5.5-6.5% as centres mature
items.quote: So, we typically have a lease cost of around 6%-7%. And as the business ramps up, the lease cost will again become a little smaller than 6%-7%. So, as these centers mature and the volumes grow, again the cost which is 6%-7% should go down to around 5.5%-6.5

items.statement: Expect H2 FY25 to be very robust after H1 was muted due to medical community protests in August-October
items.quote: See, typically our H1 is a little muted because of the problem that Bengal faced, because of the widespread protests within the medical community, which affected the months of August, September and October for us. But we expect the second half also to be very robust.

items.statement: Radiology advanced test mix expected to remain around 12-15% until pathology genetic lab is operational
items.quote: I think the mix would more or less remain the same till we start our pathology genetic lab that we are in the process of setting up. And then the mix might change to maybe 85% and 15% but not beyond that.

items.statement: Bundled tests (health packages) currently 3-4% of revenue with plans to expand
items.quote: Bundled test could be around 3%-4%.

items.statement: Commissioned 6 centres so far in FY25 with 9 more planned for Q4 FY25
items.quote: So far, we have commissioned 6 centres. And 9 centres are going to be commissioned in the fourth quarter.

items.statement: State government price capping in Northeast seen as very remote risk; governments supportive of quality diagnostic services
items.quote: The chances of this remains very remote, because of the one is an accepted fact is providing quality diagnostic or healthcare services in Northeast still remains a challenge, mainly because of the difficult terrain. So, the state government on the other hand is actually extremely helpful to people like us who are trying to set up current day services in places like Assam or Meghalaya or Tripura or

items.statement: Small centres break even in 3-4 months at INR6.5 lakhs/month revenue; large centres in 6-7 months at INR15-16 lakhs/month
items.quote: So, breakeven typically, a small centre breaks even at a revenue of around INR6.5 lakhs per month. And a big centre breaks even at around INR15-16 lakhs per month.

items.statement: Lease cost per small centre INR1-1.5 lakhs/month; per large centre INR3-7 lakhs/month depending on geography
items.quote: So, for a small center, our lease would be somewhere around INR1 lakhs to INR1.5 lakhs. And for a big center, it would be somewhere around sometimes INR3 lakhs to sometimes maybe INR7 lakhs. Depends on the geography that we are catering to

items.statement: Polyclinic consultation revenue 3.4% in H1 FY25; expected to remain 4-5% long term as it drives diagnostic volumes
items.quote: Yes, I think this quarter has been 3.4% or something. So, our first half, I think, has 3.4% of revenue coming out of consultation.

items.statement: B2B revenue approximately 6%, B2C 94%; PPP projects very small proportion and intended to stay that way
items.quote: As far as the B2B segment is concerned, our revenue is approximately 6% today and B2C is 94%.

items.statement: Northeast pricing at 20-30% premium over West Bengal/Bihar due to lack of availability
items.quote: So, typically Northeast is a little more expensive than West Bengal and Bihar. West Bengal and Bihar are similarly priced but Northeast is at a premium of around 20%-30% again because of lack of availability.

items.statement: Exploring inorganic acquisition opportunities in East and Northeast India at right price with good quality
items.quote: Yes, we are exploring inorganic opportunities as well. And, because of the consolidation happening, there are opportunities that are coming our way. And we are exploring them. And if they are at the right price with good quality diagnostics and customer centricity, we would definitely evaluate and maybe acquire a few.

items.statement: Vision to reach $1 billion AUM by FY27
items.quote: Well, I mean, yes, we mentioned that that's our vision 2027 is to at least be a billion-dollar AUM.

items.statement: Completed INR290 crores transactions in India funds in H1 FY25 with INR700 crores under term sheet
items.quote: In the India fund segment, we completed transactions worth INR290 crores with an additional INR700 crores under term sheet stage.

items.statement: Signed LOI worth INR200 crores in Dubai and have INR1,000 crores active pipeline
items.quote: We have signed LOI worth INR200 crores showcasing strategic execution in high value projects.

items.statement: Dubai fund has INR455 crores maiden investment in advanced stages of conclusion
items.quote: Our operations in Dubai are gaining significant momentum supported by the maiden investment of INR455 crores in advanced stages of conclusion and a robust pipeline of high growth projects.

items.statement: Revenue mix roughly one-third asset management and two-thirds advisory, expected to maintain
items.quote: We do maintain that we have roughly about one-third of our revenues coming from asset management and related businesses, and two-thirds of our revenue coming from advisory.

items.statement: Expect H2 revenue seasonality to continue with 60-65% of real estate revenues in second half
items.quote: If you look at real estate sales, almost about 60%-65% of the revenues in real estate happen in the second half. Usually post-monsoon, post-Diwali, etc. So we tend to see similar.

items.statement: IPO proceeds deployed per RHP for AIF business acceleration and license acquisition
items.quote: All the plans are exactly as per the RHP. We have raised money for the purpose of accelerating our AIF business, including raising money and getting licenses.

items.statement: Management fee structure ranges 1.5% to 2% of AUM depending on investor and opportunity
items.quote: As far as the fee structure is concerned, it could range from between 1.5% to 2%, depending on each investor and each opportunity.

items.statement: Carry structure targets 15% over 12% hurdle rate, significant carry expected as funds wind up
items.quote: The formula has been to earn about 15% carry over a hurdle rate of 12% and since the AUM is large, the IRR in also fairly large, I think we'll see a very healthy carry.

items.statement: Receivables lumpy due to transaction advisory payment cycles of 30-120 days, but all current with zero write-offs
items.quote: All receivables are standard. All receivables are current. All receivables are being paid as per their payment schedule. And therefore, we have zero write-offs or zero concerns with receivables.

items.statement: Expanding footprint to 20 cities in next 12 months from current Tier 1/2/3 presence
items.quote: We're already looking at being in 20 cities potentially within the next 12 months.

items.statement: Dubai fund investing in distressed completed rent-yielding assets with bank leverage
items.quote: We're investing into distressed completed rent-yielding assets. So, this is basically a yielding asset. We're only buying out ready-completed rent-earning assets in the UAE.

items.statement: NBFC acts as sponsor and co-lender for AIF investments, not building large direct lending book
items.quote: It's not something that is of great value and interest to us is to build out a very large NBFC book for direct lending. We're just acting as a co-lender and as a sponsor.

items.statement: GIFT City structure provides 10-year tax holiday for Dubai fund income
items.quote: There's a 10-year tax holiday to GIFT City. All the investments and the managers to GIFT City. GIFT City acts as your sponsor. There's a 10-year tax holiday.
